title: Why does light slow down in water?
summary: Fermilab's Don Lincoln explains why light travels slower in water and glass. He knocks down common wrong explanations such as absorption and re-emission, then gives the wave-mechanics reason tied to refractive index.
why: HN commenters link it to correct the widespread misconception about why light slows in a medium.

quote.text: See this video for an explanation of why light travels slower through a medium with an index of refraction greater than one.
